I said, “First, sir, explain who the rock and the gate are.” He said, “The rock and the gate are the Son of God.” I asked, “Why is the rock old and the gate new?” He said, “Listen and understand, you who lack understanding.”

2. “The Son of God is older than all his creation. He became the Father’s counselor in his creation.[a] That is why he is old.” I asked, “But why is the gate new, sir?”

3. He said, “He was revealed in the last days, at the end. That is why the gate became new. Those who are to be saved can enter God’s kingdom through it.”[b]

4. “You saw stones pass through the gate and go into the building of the tower. Those that did not enter were cast back to their own place.”[c] I said, “I saw them, sir.” He said, “In the same way, no one will enter God’s kingdom without receiving the name of his Son.”[d]

5. “Suppose you want to enter a city surrounded by a wall, with only one gate. Can you enter except through that gate?” I said, “How could anyone enter another way, sir?” He said, “Just as you cannot enter that city except through its gate, no one can enter God’s kingdom except through the name of his Son, whom he loves.”[e]

6. He asked, “Did you see the crowd building the tower?” I said, “I saw them, sir.” He said, “They are all glorious angels. They form a wall around the Lord.[f] The gate is the Son of God. It is the one entrance to the Lord. No one can enter his presence except through his Son.”

7. He asked, “Did you see the six men and the great, glorious man among them? He walked around the tower and rejected stones from the building.” I said, “I saw them, sir.”

8. He said, “The glorious man is the Son of God. The six are glorious angels supporting him on his right and left. None of these angels will enter God’s presence without him.[g] Whoever does not receive his name will not enter God’s kingdom.”

translation:
  text: '“First of all, sir,” I said, “explain this to me: who are the rock and the gate?” “This rock
    and the gate are the Son of God,” he said. “How, sir,” I said, “is the rock old, but the gate new?”
    “Listen and understand, you who lack understanding,” he said.


    2. “The Son of God is older than all his creation, so that he became the Father’s counselor in his
    creation.[a] That is why he is old.” “But why is the gate new, sir?” I said.


    3. “Because,” he said, “he became manifest in the last days of the consummation. That is why the gate
    became new: so that those who are to be saved might enter God’s kingdom through it.”[b]


    4. “You saw the stones that passed through the gate go into the building of the tower, and those that
    did not enter cast back to their own place?”[c] “I saw them, sir,” I said. “In the same way,” he said,
    “no one will enter God’s kingdom without receiving the name of his Son.”[d]


    5. “If you wish to enter a city that is surrounded by a wall and has only one gate, can you enter
    that city except through its gate?” “How could anyone do otherwise, sir?” I said. “If you cannot enter
    the city except through its gate, then in the same way,” he said, “a person cannot enter God’s kingdom
    except through the name of his Son, whom he loves.”[e]


    6. “Did you see the crowd building the tower?” he said. “I saw them, sir,” I said. “They are all glorious
    angels,” he said. “These form a wall around the Lord.[f] The gate is the Son of God; this is the one
    entrance to the Lord. No one, then, will enter his presence except through his Son.”


    7. “Did you see the six men and the glorious, great man among them, who walked around the tower and
    rejected stones from the building?” “I saw them, sir,” I said.


    8. “The glorious man is the Son of God,” he said. “The six are the glorious angels supporting him
    on his right and left. None of these glorious angels will enter God’s presence without him.[g] Whoever
    does not receive his name will not enter God’s kingdom.”'

translation:
  text: 'I said, “First, sir, explain who the rock and the gate are.” He said, “The rock and the gate
    are the Son of God.” I asked, “Why is the rock old and the gate new?” He said, “Listen and understand,
    you who lack understanding.”


    2. “The Son of God is older than all his creation. He became the Father’s counselor in his creation.[a]
    That is why he is old.” I asked, “But why is the gate new, sir?”


    3. He said, “He was revealed in the last days, at the end. That is why the gate became new. Those
    who are to be saved can enter God’s kingdom through it.”[b]


    4. “You saw stones pass through the gate and go into the building of the tower. Those that did not
    enter were cast back to their own place.”[c] I said, “I saw them, sir.” He said, “In the same way,
    no one will enter God’s kingdom without receiving the name of his Son.”[d]


    5. “Suppose you want to enter a city surrounded by a wall, with only one gate. Can you enter except
    through that gate?” I said, “How could anyone enter another way, sir?” He said, “Just as you cannot
    enter that city except through its gate, no one can enter God’s kingdom except through the name of
    his Son, whom he loves.”[e]


    6. He asked, “Did you see the crowd building the tower?” I said, “I saw them, sir.” He said, “They
    are all glorious angels. They form a wall around the Lord.[f] The gate is the Son of God. It is the
    one entrance to the Lord. No one can enter his presence except through his Son.”


    7. He asked, “Did you see the six men and the great, glorious man among them? He walked around the
    tower and rejected stones from the building.” I said, “I saw them, sir.”


    8. He said, “The glorious man is the Son of God. The six are glorious angels supporting him on his
    right and left. None of these angels will enter God’s presence without him.[g] Whoever does not receive
    his name will not enter God’s kingdom.”'
